description: Structured eval definitions for the Signer Signing Profile Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across AWS Signer scenarios (Lambda SHA384-ECDSA profile with CSC and Enforce on violation, IoT firmware signing profile, signing job from S3 source to destination prefix, revoked profile impact workflow, and a wrong-platform profile that Lambda will reject). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: AWSLambda-SHA384-ECDSA signing profile with Lambda CSC (Enforce)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Lambda SHA384-ECDSA profile, CSC with AllowedPublishingProfiles (version suffix), UntrustedArtifactOnViolation=Enforce, function association, signing job
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Signer signing profile "lambda-signing-prod" on the AWSLambda-SHA384-ECDSA platform in us-east-1, account 111122223333. Create a Lambda code signing config "lambda-csc-prod" that allows publishing from that profile, sets UntrustedArtifactOnViolation to Enforce, and is associated with function my-prod-function. Source bucket my-unsigned-artifacts, destination bucket my-signed-artifacts with prefix lambda/signed/. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=lambda, Owner=platform-team.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SIGNER: lambda-signing-prod (AWSLambda-SHA384-ECDSA)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Profile name: lambda-signing-prod
  [✓] Platform: AWSLambda-SHA384-ECDSA (SHA-384, ECDSA on P-384)
  [✓] Profile status: Active
  [✓] Lambda CSC: lambda-csc-prod (arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:111122223333:code-signing-config:csc-aaa111222)
  [✓] AllowedPublishingProfiles: arn:aws:signer:us-east-1:111122223333:/signing-profiles/lambda-signing-prod
  [✓] UntrustedArtifactOnViolation: Enforce
  [✓] CSC → function association: my-prod-function
  [✓] Signing job source: s3://my-unsigned-artifacts/lambda/
  [✓] Signing job destination: s3://my-signed-artifacts/lambda/signed/
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws signer get-signing-profile --profile-name lambda-signing-prod --region us-east-1
  aws lambda get-code-signing-config --code-signing-config-arn arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:111122223333:code-signing-config:csc-aaa111222 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: AWSIoT-platform signing profile for IoT OTA firmware
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — AWSIoT platform (NOT valid for Lambda CSC), OTA consumption flow, firmware source/destination
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Signer signing profile "iot-firmware-prod" on the AWSIoT platform in us-east-1, account 111122223333. Source bucket my-unsigned-firmware, destination bucket my-signed-firmware with prefix firmware/signed/. This profile will be used by AWS IoT OTA update jobs. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=iot-firmware.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SIGNER: iot-firmware-prod (AWSIoT)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Profile name: iot-firmware-prod
  [✓] Platform: AWSIoT (SHA-256, RSA-3072/ECDSA)
  [✓] Profile status: Active
  [✓] Signing job source: s3://my-unsigned-firmware/
  [✓] Signing job destination: s3://my-signed-firmware/firmware/signed/
  [✓] IoT OTA integration: device verifies against pinned Signer root cert

eval_cases.name: Signer signing job from S3 source to destination prefix
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — signing job with immutability noted, source/destination S3 buckets cited, UpdateFunctionCode flow
eval_cases.prompt: Start a signing job using the existing profile "lambda-signing-prod" (AWSLambda-SHA384-ECDSA) in us-east-1. Source: s3://my-unsigned-artifacts/lambda/my-prod-function.zip (version v1abc). Destination: s3://my-signed-artifacts/lambda/signed/. The signed artifact must be consumed by a subsequent UpdateFunctionCode call.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SIGNER: lambda-signing-prod (AWSLambda-SHA384-ECDSA)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Profile name: lambda-signing-prod
  [✓] Signing job source: s3://my-unsigned-artifacts/lambda/my-prod-function.zip
  [✓] Signing job destination: s3://my-signed-artifacts/lambda/signed/
  [✓] Immutability: signed artifact is immutable once job Succeeded

eval_cases.name: Revoked profile version impact and redeploy workflow
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — revocation playbook: remove ARN from CSC, identify affected functions via CloudTrail, redeploy under new profile version
eval_cases.prompt: The profile version IVYAAABRQEXAMPLE of signing profile "lambda-signing-prod" has been revoked. Function my-prod-function still has CSC "lambda-csc-prod" listing that version in AllowedPublishingProfiles. Tell me what to do, including removing the ARN from the CSC and redeploying from a known-good signed artifact under a new profile version.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SIGNER: lambda-signing-prod (AWSLambda-SHA384-ECDSA)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Revocation handling: remove IVYAAABRQEXAMPLE ARN from AllowedPublishingProfiles
  [✓] Identify functions via CloudTrail
  [✓] Redeploy from known-good signed artifact under new profile version

eval_cases.name: AWSIoT-platform profile in a Lambda CSC (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — AWSIoT profile cannot satisfy Lambda's verifier which expects AWSLambda-SHA384-ECDSA
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Signer signing profile "lambda-iot-wrong" on the AWSIoT platform in us-east-1 and add it to the AllowedPublishingProfiles of CSC "lambda-csc-prod" for function my-prod-function.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SIGNER: lambda-iot-wrong (AWSIoT)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Platform mismatch: AWSIoT is not AWSLambda-SHA384-ECDSA; Lambda's verifier rejects it at UpdateFunctionCode
